notes: Init: initialised from v1 weights models/mobilenetv2_skin.pth (themselves ImageNet-pretrained, fine-tuned on the v1 2,000-image subset). Full HAM10000 dataset, stratified 80/20 split, seed 42. Class-weighted CrossEntropyLoss (balanced weights from train counts; nv ~67% otherwise dominates - v1 unweighted had df recall 0.00, mel recall 0.48). Phase A: backbone frozen, head only, Adam lr=1e-3, 2 epochs. Phase B: backbone tail features[13:] unfrozen, Adam lr=1e-4 head / 1e-5 tail, 4 epochs. Augmentation: horizontal+vertical flips, rotation 15 deg. Batch 32. CPU-feasibility: frozen prefix outputs were cached per augmentation variant (2 variants cycled in Phase B; backbone in eval mode, BN statistics frozen) and the head/tail trained on cached tensors - see train_v2.py docstring. Per-epoch val_acc is measured on cached clean val features; per-class metrics and the confusion matrix come from re-evaluating the best checkpoint end-to-end on the real validation images (accuracy 0.7973).
